thread:
emily_sales: Heads up - MercuryCredit procurement asked for a compact assurance bundle for the upcoming POC. They want: redacted SOC2 AOC, ISO27001 certificate excerpt, a signed pen-test attestation (their template attached), and a one-page network diagram. They also asked for an estimate if we include a short Dedicated trial. Can legal sign the attestation?

jon_sec: We can provide redacted SOC2 AOC + ISO excerpt. For the pen-test attestation we need to confirm allowed IPs and explicit scope (staging only). If they want unredacted report, we'll require an NDA.

ravi_eng: Dedicated trial adds infra + ops overhead. Quick estimate for a 2-week reserved mini-pool: approx +20-30% on top of hosted list price, depending on GPU mix. Also if they expect active scanning against our environment we need a scheduled maintenance window and IP allowlist.

tessa_legal: I can sign the attestation on company letterhead. Requirements: (1) exact scope string, (2) PO or SOW reference OR short note that it's a POC without billing (we prefer PO), (3) customer template filled out. Turnaround: ~48-72 hours after receipt of those items.

hana_devops: If scans are inbound we need CIDR ranges and start/end times. Otherwise we can accept upload of results to a presigned bucket. Example presign:
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/mercurycredit/mercury-poc-evidence.zip --expires-in 604800
```
I'll create the bucket and runbook once scope is confirmed.

emily_sales: Customer attached template in email. They named scope: "*.staging.mercurycredit-app.com" and asked to include a dedicated node pool if used. They said they prefer not to sign an NDA but procurement might accept redacted docs.

jon_sec: Proposed scope wording to legal: "Scope: security testing limited to staging.mercurycredit-app.com and associated staging infrastructure for the MercuryCredit POC. Production systems and customer data are out-of-scope. Dedicated pool included only if explicitly requested and paid for in the PO." Approve?

tessa_legal: That wording is fine. We will not accept broad indemnities; this is an attestation only. I'll sign after PO/SOW reference. If they refuse PO, we can accept a short signed POC cover note.

emily_sales: I'll ask procurement to issue a small PO referencing the POC and confirm Dedicated preference. ETA EOD.

evidence-bot: evidence-system: Presigned evidence bucket created: s3://redwood-evidence/mercurycredit/ (expires in 7 days) :white_check_mark:

hana_devops: Runbook checklist I'll include: allowed scan window, contact for emergency kill switch, presigned upload steps, and our validators.

emily_sales: Perfect — thanks. One more: they asked if pen-test letter can list a contact name for Redwood. Who should we use?

tessa_legal: Use me (Tessa Moran) as signatory and Jon (jon_sec) as technical contact.

emily_sales: Great, pinging MercuryCredit now. Will update thread after PO comes through :thumbsup:
